title: 88Vape Any Tank Liquorice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Liquorice from 88Vape is a classic sweetshop favourite vape Juice form. Bold and punchy, sweet and spicy, this delicious e-liquid conjures timeless memories of the tuck shop with every swoonful vape. This vape juice from 88Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing delicious flavour, smooth throat yet tactile throat hit and satisfying clouds. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. 88Vape are one of the most popular and bestselling vape brands in the UK. They have helped countless smokers make the switch to the far safer alternative of vaping with the help of delicious e-liquids at budget-friendly prices. Their 50/50 e-liquids are suitable for most kinds of vape devices, so users can enjoy their favourite flavours with the minimum of fuss. Please Note: that the 3mg & 6mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 11mg & 16mg nicotine strengths contain 30VG/70PG.
